name: Availability zones
short_description: Physically separate locations within an Azure region, each with its own power, cooling and networking, used to spread workloads so a failure in one zone does not take down every instance.

evidence.quote: An availability zone is a separate physical location inside an Azure region with its own power, cooling and network.
The gateway spreads itself across at least two availability zones by default
